meta.name: analyzing-browser-forensics-with-hindsight
meta.description: Analyze Chromium-based browser artifacts using Hindsight to extract browsing history, downloads, cookies, cached content, autofill data, saved passwords, and browser extensions from Chrome, Edge, Brave, and Opera for forensic investigation.

copy.tagline: 提取 Chromium 浏览器痕迹用于取证分析
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从 Chrome、Edge 等浏览器中提取历史记录、密码等痕迹进行取证。
copy.tagline_en: Extract Chromium browser artifacts for forensic analysis

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能分析 Chromium 浏览器（Chrome、Edge、Brave、Opera 等）的痕迹数据，提取浏览历史、下载记录、Cookie、缓存、自动填充、保存的密码和扩展信息，并生成时间线报告。
howto.when: 当你需要调查安全事件、重建用户网页活动，或验证浏览器取证覆盖范围时，可以要求 Claude 分析浏览器痕迹。

say.text: 分析这个 Chrome 用户数据目录，提取浏览历史和下载记录。
say.note: Claude 会运行 Hindsight 并输出报告。

say.text: 帮我从 Edge 浏览器痕迹中找出可疑的 Cookie 和登录信息。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can analyze Chromium-based browser artifacts (Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera) to extract browsing history, downloads, cookies, cache, autofill, saved passwords, and extensions, producing a timeline report.
howto.when_en: When you need to investigate security incidents, reconstruct user web activity, or validate browser forensics coverage, ask Claude to analyze browser artifacts.

say_en.text: Analyze this Chrome user data directory and extract browsing history and downloads.
say_en.note: Claude will run Hindsight and output a report.

say_en.text: Find suspicious cookies and login data from Edge browser artifacts.
say_en.note: Claude will parse Cookie and Login Data files.
